title: apparule.orders.transition
description: common (outbox) -> commerce, on cuelabs.requests. An order changed state (order-lifecycle.md §1). commerce acts on the money transitions: `delivered` releases the payout (quote - fee), `refunded` refunds the charge; it ignores the rest. Everything a money decision needs travels here, because commerce has no store. Key: request id.

transition_id.description: The ORDER_EVENT id; commerce's idempotency reference with Paystack.

payment.description: The held charge, present from `paid` onward.

payout_recipient.description: The designer's verified Paystack transfer recipient, on `delivered`.
